conventions.precision_at_5: unique relevant IDs in first five / 5, including short result sets; shown alongside returned_precision
conventions.recall_at_30: macro average over positive queries only; negative queries have a separate contamination rate
conventions.mrr: first relevant rank, averaged over positive queries only
conventions.mock_quality: contract replay only; never evidence of real model semantic accuracy
conventions.load_backpressure: HTTP 409/429 retries are counted and timed; only admitted/acknowledged requests count as accepted messages
conventions.go: all mandatory and quality targets satisfied on final code; missing real-service evidence means NO-GO
